sow_requirements.text: Project SOW: Enterprise Vessel Management Solution. Client Partner: HPCL. Summary: The Enterprise Vessel Management Solution project aims to implement a comprehensive vessel management system for HPCL, covering chartering, voyage execution, demurrage, claims, finance, analytics, and document repository.. Competencies and Stack: VMS Platform, COTS, AIS-based real-time vessel tracking, Predictive ETA/ETB, Route deviation, delay and laycan-miss alerts, Historical vessel track and movement database, Fleet monitoring dashboard with role-wise visibility, Dynamic vessel scheduling, Vessel-cargo assignment, Multi-port and multi-cargo scheduling, Route sequencing and port-call sequencing, Cost-based optimization, Constraint-based scheduling, What-if simulation, Predictive planning, Inventory and demand signals, Product-sharing constraints, LPG/SOD/crude predictive scheduling, Supply-risk alerts, API for scheduling, Vessel requisition workflow, Charter enquiry creation and floating, Bid, offer, counter-offer and negotiation tracking, Captures CP clauses, Crude API, GST Act/Rules/requirements, Tax invoices, Payment of taxes, Returns filing. Deliverables: Optimization Engine; Dynamic Scheduling Module; What-if Simulation Engine; Decision Support Dashboard; Constraint Configuration Framework; Optimization Reports; Audit and Traceability; Configured Application Modules; Custom Development Components; Requirement Validation Document; Gap Analysis Report; Solution Blueprint Document; To-Be Process Maps; Functional Design Specifications; Approved Project Plan; Governance Structure Document; Resource Deployment Plan; Communication and Reporting Plan. Delivery Risks: Insufficient Time for Development and Testing; Integration Complexity with COTS and VMS Platform; Data Quality and Availability Issues with AIS-based Real-time Vessel Tracking; Cost Overruns due to Unforeseen Technical Challenges; Non-Compliance with GST Act/Rules/Requirements; Dependence on AIS-based Real-time Vessel Tracking and COTS Vendors; Insufficient Skilled Resources for Development and Testing; Delays in Approval of Project Plan and Governance Structure.
